title: Nie piję kawy · dopełniacz
title_en: The genitive after nie — not just after nie mam
note:
B2 Block 6, unit 1. The genitive of negation, generalised off mieć. a1_negation taught nie mam kawy at A1 as a fact about ONE verb; it is a fact about every negated transitive verb, and this unit says so.

ONE NEW LEMMA IN THE WHOLE UNIT — chleba — and it is here for the reason the tree node itself flagged. The unit states 'masculine takes -u' (telefon -> telefonu, pokój -> pokoju, dom -> domu), and chleb is the one high-frequency masculine in this course that refuses it. chleb has been owned since leaf_food_a1, it is inside poproszę chleb, and b2_jesli's own type stage has kupię chleb — so teaching the rule while leaving chleba out would set Dad up to build chlebu on a word he uses constantly. Handed over as ONE boxed exception (the dziećmi / ludźmi / kelnerzy closed-set idiom), never as a sub-rule, and the non-word chlebu is never printed anywhere, distractors included.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS RECYCLED, which is why a rule this broad is cheap. Both halves of every pair are owned: accusatives kawę, wodę, herbatę, zupę, książkę, mleko, piwo, telefon, psa (a1_miec, trunk_want_like_a1, a1_gender) and genitives kawy, wody, herbaty, zupy, książki, mleka, piwa, telefonu, pokoju, domu, czasu, psa (a1_gen_endings, a1_gen_ki, a1_negation). Verbs are all owned too: mam, piję, czytam, kupuję, robię, pije, kupowała, czytał, kupiłem.

THE MATCH BOARD IS SIX MINIMAL PAIRS, positive row then negative row, because the contrast IS the content. A board of negatives alone would show the new forms and hide the fact that makes them new.

THE MASCULINE-ANIMATE ROW IS THE RELIEF SLIDE IN MINIATURE: Mam psa -> Nie mam psa, nothing changes at all, because AGENTS.md's named Acc=Gen exception means the object form of a man or an animal already IS the genitive. It is the last pair on the board on purpose.

SLIDE 3 IS A GUARD AGAINST OVER-APPLICATION and is deliberate rather than a second fact. Only a direct OBJECT moves. Nie mieszkam w domu (Locative), Nie jestem lekarzem (Instrumental), Nie idę do sklepu (already Genitive) and Nie pomagam mamie (Dative) are all completely unchanged. Quiz items 11 and 12 are that guard, in the idiom of b2_num_virile's osoba guard — a learner who has just been told 'nie moves the word after it' will move the wrong ones.

HOMOGRAPH / TAUGHT-AS CHECKS:
- gazety stays out of every object slot. a2_plural_nom owns that string as a NOMINATIVE PLURAL, and using it as a genitive singular of gazeta is the homograph trap itself.
- drogi appears nowhere, as in every pack since b2_gen_pl_full: leaf_shopping_a1 owns that string as the ADJECTIVE 'expensive'.
- wina is not used as a genitive of wino — a2_plural_nom owns it as a nominative plural.
- piwa is used ONLY as a genitive singular, which is what a1_gen_endings taught it as in dużo piwa; no slide calls it a plural.
- książki is a genitive singular here (a1_gen_ki, nie mam książki), never a plural, and książek is used as the distractor that names the plural.
- psa and kota are the masculine-animate honest exception AGENTS.md names: the accusative really is identical to the genitive, and slide 2 gives it its own row rather than letting it slip past.

FENCED, and logged:
- PLURAL OBJECTS. Nie mam gazet is fully legal by this point (b2_gen_pl_full is three nodes back) and is still held. The unit has one fact and number is orthogonal to it; b2_case_gym and b2_wrapup are where the recombination belongs. This is the one scope call in the pack James might want to overturn.
- samochodu, adresu, cukru, soku, biletu, klucza, kurtkę — all verified NEW, all absent.
- chlebu — never printed, because it is precisely the non-word this unit's exception exists to prevent.
- No oblique pronouns (go, ją, cię, nim, niej). Every object here is a noun. Note the auditor cannot see this fence: person pronouns sit in audit.py's GLUE_LEMMAS, so it is author discipline only.
- No plural oblique adjectives (spine O3 -> C1). This unit is bare-noun throughout, the seventh in a row.

Bare governed prepositions (w, do) are not listed in uses_lemmas per SEQUENCING.md 6.3 — their jobs ride prep_w_loc, prep_place and prep_do_gen in uses_structures.

intro.title: It was never really about mieć
intro.title_pl: nie mam kawy · nie piję kawy · nie czytam książki
intro.body:
Since A1 you have said Nie mam kawy, and you learned it as something mieć does. It is not. Every verb that takes an object does the same thing: put nie in front, and the object switches to the of-form.

So you already know the forms. You have been using them after nie mam, after dużo and after do since A1. All that changes today is how many verbs they turn up after — which is all of them.
intro.body_pl: Mam kawę · Nie mam kawy · Piję kawę · Nie piję kawy

rows: the same switch, a different verb
nothing — see the last row of the next slide

intro.title: The endings are the ones you already have
intro.body:
This is the same table you learned in A1 for dużo and do. Nothing on it is new except the last two rows, and only one of those is genuinely a new word.

The bottom row is the good news: for a man or an animal, the object form and the of-form are already the same word, so nie changes nothing at all.
intro.body_pl: kawę → kawy · książkę → książki · mleko → mleka · telefon → telefonu · psa → psa

intro.title: Only the object moves
intro.title_pl: nie mieszkam w domu · nie jestem lekarzem · nie idę do sklepu
intro.body:
Now the guard, because this is where the rule is easy to over-use. nie does not touch everything behind it. It moves the object and nothing else.

If the word after the verb was already doing some other job — a place after w, who you are after jestem, where you are going after do — it stays exactly as it was. Read the table as: nie changed nothing in any of these.
intro.body_pl: tylko biernik → dopełniacz · miejscownik · narzędnik · celownik

rows: yes — that is the whole lesson
where you are going after do
no — it was already the of-form

quiz.explain: nie pulls the of-form. kawę is what you say after a positive mam, kawa is the plain naming form, and kaw is the of-form of more than one coffee.
Neuter words never change to be an object, so Piję piwo has piwo — but nie still moves it, to piwa. piw is the plural of-form and kawy belongs to kawa.
The -ka words take -i rather than -y, because Polish never writes y after k — the same spelling fact you met in do apteki. książkę is the object form after a positive czytam.
robić takes an object like any other verb, so nie moves it: zupę becomes zupy. Nothing about robić is special here, and that is the point of the lesson.
Same switch as kawę → kawy. herbat is the of-form of more than one tea, which you would need after dużo or after a number from five up.
Masculine words take -u — the same telefonu you have used since A1 after dużo. telefon is the object form after a positive mam; telefony and telefonów are plurals.
pokój takes -u like every other masculine word, and its ó becomes o on the way: pokoju. domu and sklepu are the same ending on two other words.
This is the easy one. For a man or an animal the object form is already the of-form, so psa is right with nie and without it. kota is the same story for a cat; pies is the plain naming form.
chleb is the one masculine word in this course that does not take -u. It takes -a, and there is no reason for it — learn chleba as its own word.
Neuter words take -a: mleko becomes mleka. piwa and wody are the same job on two other drinks, and mleko is the form you would use with no nie in front.
A trap, and worth getting wrong once. Nothing moves here: dom is not the object, it is a place after w, and w has taken domu since A1. The nie changes nothing.
jestem keeps its -em form whether or not there is a nie in front of it. Only an object moves, and who you are is not an object.
